display_name: George of Samothrace (second of the two)

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 6 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Γεώργιος, Μανουήλ, Θεόδωρος, Γεώργιος και Μιχαήλ από τη Σαμοθράκη», with the rank word and the place left off. He is the second of the two Georges the line names.

death.note: saint.gr heads each of the five «(; - 1835)»; its 6 Απριλίου page gives no month or day of the martyrdom and refers the life itself to Thomas Sunday.

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 6ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Γεώργιος, Μανουήλ, Θεόδωρος, Γεώργιος και Μιχαήλ από τη Σαμοθράκη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 6 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, but for the life itself says «Βλέπε βιογραφικό τους σημείωμα την Κυριακή του Θωμά», a moveable day which is not recorded here. The page's hymns keep the two Georges together as «οἱ διττοὶ Γεώργιοι» and distinguish them nowhere; this folder is the second of the two in the page's own order, and no more is claimed for the distinction than that.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
